welcome.title: Welcome to the dashboard!
welcome.body: Here you can see each child's daily progress. Tap a child card to view and edit their schedule.

stars.title: Stars & treasure chest
stars.body: Every completed activity earns 1 star. Your child collects stars and redeems them for rewards in the treasure chest.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule & activities
